objects.name: The Grieving Stone
objects.vInscr: Worn to a taper by mourners' hands. The rain in its hollow never freezes.

objects.name: Chalked Waystone
objects.vInscr: Kindled by pilgrims. Touch it, and every lit waystone on the Hide knows your step.

landmarks.name: The King Who Waited
landmarks.inscription: He was buried sitting up, so he would be ready when the god called his name. The god has died. He is ready still.

landmarks.name: The Paid Witness
landmarks.inscription: Its priests put out its eyes so it could not see what was done in its name, and paid it for the loss. It is still holding out its hands.

lights.source: shaft (cold light through vault cracks, pulses)
